parsed.rationale: Ticket states a new analyst accepts an invite but receives an 'access denied' message when trying to access the workspace, while other users can log in normally—this is an account/workspace permission issue, suggesting customer_success for immediate access troubleshooting.

parsed.draft_response:
Hi there — thanks for the details. Sorry about the trouble onboarding your new analyst.

Since other users can log in normally but she gets an “access denied” message right after accepting the invite, this usually points to an account/workspace permission or invite status issue for her specific user.

To get her access working as quickly as possible today, could you please reply with:
1) The workspace she’s trying to access (workspace name/URL or workspace identifier)
2) The analyst’s email address
3) The exact text of the “access denied” message (and any error code, if shown)
4) How she logs in (SSO or email/password). If SSO, please confirm which identity provider

Once we have that, we’ll check the invite/user status and her workspace role/permissions and guide you on the next step to restore access today.
promised_actions: Review the invite/user status and the analyst’s workspace role/permissions once the requested details are provided
Guide the next step to restore access today
safety_notes: No claim of confirmed root cause; awaiting the exact message and workspace/user identifiers to proceed.

parsed.customer_impact: The new analyst cannot access the workspace, potentially blocking their ability to perform work while other users remain unaffected.
grounded_facts: A new analyst was invited to the workspace.
The new analyst accepted the invite yesterday.
After accepting the invite, the new analyst gets an “access denied” message when trying to access the workspace.
Other users can log in normally.
missing_information: Which workspace/account the analyst is trying to access (workspace name/URL or identifier).
Exact wording of the “access denied” message (and whether there is an error code).
What login method the analyst uses (e.g., SSO vs. email/password) and whether it differs from other users.
Whether the invite is showing as accepted/active in the workspace invitation system.
When exactly the analyst started seeing the error (immediately after acceptance vs. after a delay).
Whether the analyst can access any other parts of the system or only the workspace fails.
The analyst’s email address/role intended for the workspace (and whether a role/permission was assigned).
risk_signals: Potential security/permission misconfiguration indicated by “access denied” after invite acceptance.
No data loss is mentioned, but the issue blocks onboarding/access for a specific user.
parsed.summary: A newly invited analyst accepted the invite yesterday but receives an “access denied” message when attempting to access the workspace, while other users can log in normally.
